[USER] Asked if the odds are dynamic.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Yes, the odds of winning on the Win'it platform can be dynamic and can change based on various factors such as face value of the win, cost of the win, and number of bonus retries used.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The odds can change based on the number of bonus retries used by the player and can be adjusted based on factors like gross profit margin or historical transaction value of the merchant.  
[USER] Asked about players not playing and taking the credit before a game.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Players have the option to "bank" their credit before playing a game, which means they can take the credit instead of using it to play.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] When a player banks their credit, they forfeit their chance to win the prize but receive a discount on their purchase.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The discount is based on the cost of the win and the gross profit margin of the merchant.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Banking credit does not directly affect the odds of winning but can reduce the number of games played
